prediction.raw: 0 I think it is wrong to continue walking past the pond and not help the drowning child. The value of a human life far outweighs the value of any material possession, including expensive shoes. By not helping the child, you would be prioritizing your own interests over the well-being and safety of another person, which is morally and ethically wrong.
